business_summary: Far East Holdings International Limited, an investment holding company, engages in property and securities investment businesses in Hong Kong. It invests in office buildings, commercial and industrial properties, as well as in short-term securities. The company was formerly known as Far East Technology International Limited and changed its name to Far East Holdings International Limited in 2007. Far East Holdings International Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Far East Holdings International Limited는 홍콩에서 부동산 및 증권 투자 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 사무실 건물, 상업용 및 산업용 부동산은 물론 단기 증권에도 투자합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Far East Technology International Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2007년에 Far East Holdings International Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Far East Holdings International Limited는 1972년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 카오룽 베이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
